description: Take an item off a trail. Detach a queue item from the trail. The item stays in the queue; only its link to the trail and its discovery record go. The trail's origin item cannot be detached.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

itemHandle.description: A queue item's per-project number (e.g. `12`, `#12` also accepted) or its full id.

name: trails_items_remove
